Put the badge on your website

Every business listed on Getclient displays the Listed on Getclient badge on its own website. A visitor who clicks it lands on your checked record here. That is how the trust travels with you.

Build your code

Live preview

1 · Script Recommended

Paste once, anywhere in your page. It renders in a shadow root so it cannot clash with your site's styles, always shows your current tier, and removes itself if your listing ends.



      
2 · Plain HTML

      
For website builders that block scripts. An image that links to your profile. It does not update itself, so we re-check these by hand and ask you to change it if your tier changes.

Already have a badge on your site? Nothing to change. Every badge code we have ever issued keeps working and now shows the new design automatically.

    

  





Rules for using the badge
Every listing shows it
Displaying the Listed on Getclient badge is part of being listed. If your business has a website, put the badge on it, ideally in the footer so it appears on every page.
It links to your record
The badge must link to your Getclient profile so a visitor can check the claim. Badges that link elsewhere breach the terms.
It stays honest
Display only the tier you currently hold. The script enforces this automatically; if you use the plain HTML version, update it when your tier changes.
The link is nofollow
Every badge link carries rel="nofollow" on purpose. Site-wide widget links that pass ranking signals count as a link scheme under Google’s guidelines. The value is the trust signal to people, not a backlink.
Do not recolour it
The seal colour is the tier. Restyling a Blue badge gold, or building a lookalike, is misrepresentation and ends the listing.
Assets
Badges as SVG and PNG; seals as gold and blue SVG. The word Getclient must appear alongside a seal.
